data.subject: [HR-1012] Final notice before I file in small claims
data.description:
Market: US
Language: en
Order: HR-US-90144
Received: 2026-09-19T14:02:00Z
Source channel: email

To whom it may concern,

My Halden & Reed stand mixer stopped working after 14 months. Your warranty page says 24 months, but I was told by your agent that the motor is "not covered". I have now been refused a repair or replacement twice.

If I do not receive a replacement within 10 days, I will file a claim in small claims court and I will also post the full email exchange on social media. My attorney friend has told me your warranty wording is misleading.

Rachel Stone
